results.title: The Beginning of the End
results.plot: Through the wild backdrop of the Lincoln County War, the legendary Billy the Kid becomes ensnared in a deadly game of cat and mouse as lawman Pat Garrett orchestrates the ultimate trap.

results.title: Two Shots
results.plot: Billy and the Regulators are ambushed by Garrett after a betrayal and Jesse deals with a loss, while Catron has a conflict with his daughter as he tries to seize The House from Riley.

results.title: Take Your Medicine
results.plot: After another surprise attack from Garrett, Billy loses a trusted friend forcing him to seek revenge while Emily makes a calculated decision to reconcile with her father by asking for help.

results.title: The Shepherd's Hut
results.plot: Garrett and his posse relentlessly pursue Billy and the Regulators and after a tense stand-off, several close allies are forced to choose between loyalty and survival.

results.title: Breaking the Shackles
results.plot: Garrett doggedly searches the New Mexico Territory, but with the support of friends and allies, Billy stays one step ahead of the determined pursuit.

results.title: The Chain Gang
results.plot: Billy reunites with family during recovery as the Regulators plan a prison break for a friend. Meanwhile, Garrett reveals to Emily the truth about Edgar and her father's role.

results.title: The Last Buffalo
results.plot: Years after losing his badge in shame, Pat Garrett confronts his past when Billy and Jesse track him down for revenge and their own frontier justice.

results.title: The Redeemed
results.plot: Billy seeks vengeance against Thomas Catron in New Mexico, joining forces with Governor's daughter Emily. His final quest for justice brings the legendary outlaw's tale to its ultimate conclusion.
